01 · The Utility

CSPTCL — the state transmission backbone

  • Government-owned transmission utility for the state of Chhattisgarh
  • Manages the EHV & HV network — moving power from generating stations to distribution substations
  • Successor of the former Chhattisgarh State Electricity Board (CSEB)
  • Operates the statewide network of transmission lines & substations — including Tifra 132 kV
132 kV
Tifra's voltage level
NetworkEHV + HV
PredecessorCSEB
RoleTransmission
[4]
CSPTCL ek government company hai jo high voltage pe bijli transmit karti hai pure Chhattisgarh mein. Yeh purani State Electricity Board ka successor hai aur generation se distribution tak reliable power flow ensure karti hai.

01 · The Plant

Tifra — a 132 kV grid node

  • Located in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh — a critical node in the CSPTCL network
  • Receives bulk power from 220 / 400 kV networks, steps down to 132 kV
  • Switchyard: circuit breakers, isolators, instrument transformers, busbars
  • Control room: protection panels, PLCC panels, RTU, transducers
  • A vital data-acquisition point — its telemetry is the State Load Dispatch Centre's (SLDC) window into this region
Tifra Substation 220/400 kV se power leke 132 kV pe step-down karta hai, aur saath hi continuously grid data collect karke SLDC ko bhejta hai. Iska matlab iska communication equipment jitna reliable, utni hi SLDC ko visibility milegi.

Yard mein high voltage equipment hota hai, control room mein electronics — aur dono ko coaxial cable jodta hai. Maine hamesha PPE pehna aur sab kuch supervised observation ke through seekha, kabhi live circuit touch nahi kiya. Panel data ko sensitive treat kiya gaya.

02 · Why C&T exists

No visibility, no grid

The Communication & Telemetry department builds and maintains the grid's information layer — power flows on copper, but the grid runs on data.

MeasurementskW · kVAR · Hz · kV
Status & alarmsBreakers · isolators · faults
Protection commandsTeleprotection trips
Voice & dataSwitching coordination
No data link → no dispatch. The C&T layer is what turns copper and steel into a controllable grid.
Jaise nervous system brain tak signals bhejta hai, waise hi C&T department substation ka data — voltage, power, alarms — SLDC tak bhejta hai, jisse grid control possible hota hai. Power flow alag hai, information flow se grid stable operate hota hai.

02 · Why C&T exists

Three media, one job

PLCC
this training

The HV line itself is the medium

A high-frequency carrier rides the same 50 Hz conductors that move bulk power — no new cable, no new towers.

mediumthe HV conductor itself
signal30–500 kHz carrier
roleprotection · telemetry · voice
Microwave

Radio, tower to tower

Line-of-sight links between designated sites — high bandwidth, but the towers must be able to see each other.

mediumradio waves, tower to tower
signalGHz-band beam
rolepoint-to-point backbone links
OPGW & fibre

Light along the earth wire

Optical ground wire over the transmission line — high-speed, high-capacity digital communication.

mediumlight in fibre, in the earth wire
signalhigh-capacity digital
rolethe modern digital backbone
Different paths, one job: every medium exists so the grid can be watched, switched and protected in real time. This training followed PLCC — the medium already built into every 132 kV line.
Teen main technologies hain — PLCC power line use karta hai, Microwave ko towers ek dusre ko dekhna chahiye (line-of-sight), aur OPGW fibre sabse fast hai. Meri training PLCC pe focused thi, isliye aage ka focus PLCC aur telemetry pe rahega.

03 · PLCC

The power line is the signal line

1 50 Hz power — the bulk energy
f = 50 Hz
2 HF carrier — the information
30–500 kHz
3 Superimposed — both ride one conductor
50 Hz + HF
The idea in one number
30–500 kHz

Where they sit on the spectrum
Cost-effectiveReliable under faultsNo new cable

The carrier path survives as long as the line is physically intact — which is exactly when teleprotection matters most.

One conductor, two worlds: 50 Hz moves the power, kilohertz carries the information — C&T equipment keeps them apart.
[1]
PLCC ka concept simple hai — naya cable bichhane ke bajaye, same power line pe high-frequency signal superimpose kar dete hain. Yeh cost-effective aur reliable dono hai, especially fault conditions mein jab other channels fail ho sakte hain.

03 · PLCC

Three jobs on one carrier

  Telemetry

Live grid parameters — active power, reactive power, frequency, voltage — streamed to the control centre.

  Teleprotection

Instantaneous trip commands to breakers at both line ends when a fault strikes — milliseconds decide stability.

  Telephony

Voice channels between operating personnel — switching instructions and coordinated maintenance.

At Tifra

All three functions ride the same carrier, on the same 132 kV lines, handled by the same PLCC chain.

PLCC teen kaam karta hai — telemetry data bhejta hai, fault ke time turant tripping command bhejta hai (yeh milliseconds-critical hai), aur engineers ke beech voice communication bhi karta hai.

03 · PLCC

The coupling chain — as built

As built, left to right: panel → coax → LMU → coupling capacitor → 132 kV line — with the wave trap standing guard in series on the line itself, never inside the carrier's path.
Yeh poora signal path hai — panel se coax, phir LMU, phir CVT se line pe. Important baat: Line Trap main path mein nahi hota. Wo line arrangement ka part hai jo carrier ko busbar mein jaane se rokta hai. Actual gateway Coupling Capacitor hai. Yeh distinction report ka key insight hai.

04 · Equipment anatomy

The Line Trap — opened up

Auto demo — sweeps 50 Hz → 500 kHz & opens the trap by itself · hover or ←/→ to take over f = 50 Hz · |Z| = 0.06 Ω · power passes
1
Main coil — the bright winding
Stranded aluminium coil in series with the line; carries the full line current continuously
2
Tuning pack — inside the coil
Capacitor + resistor tune the parallel resonance to the carrier band
3
Top terminal & corona shield
HV connection; the rounded ring prevents corona discharge at 132 kV
4
Post insulators & channel
Isolate the trap from its support; sheds shed rain and pollution
5
Impedance dial
Reads what the trap presents: 0.06 Ω at 50 Hz, ~800 Ω at resonance
6
Frequency control
Sweeps the test frequency from 50 Hz to 500 kHz — across the carrier band
Yeh line trap ka anatomy figure hai — ekdum real test stand jaisa. Figure pe hover karke frequency sweep karo: 50 Hz pe impedance dial 0.06 ohm dikhaata hai (power pass), carrier band pe 800 ohm (carrier blocked). Arrow keys se trap khul jaata hai — andar tuning pack dikhta hai: capacitor aur resistor. Hi-Z at carrier, Lo-Z at 50 Hz — yahi line trap ka kaam hai.

The coupling capacitor — the gateway

Interactive 3D — live cutaway
cutaway · opening…
Corona ring Porcelain housing Capacitor stack Base tank
amber dots = carrier energy coupling through
  • Low impedance to the carrier — HF energy passes into the LMU
  • High impedance to 50 Hz — the electronics never see the HV
  • Often doubles as a CVT — a scaled voltage for metering & protection
  • The primary interface between the HV line and the PLCC equipment
HF ↓
low Z at carrier
50 Hz ↑
high Z at power
CVT
duty: measure + couple
[2]
CVT carrier ko line pe inject aur extract karta hai — carrier ke liye low impedance, 50 Hz high voltage ke liye high impedance. Kai sites mein yeh voltage transformer ka kaam bhi karta hai, isliye CVT kehte hain. Yeh line aur electronics ke beech ka safe interface hai.

04 · Equipment anatomy

Two gatekeepers, opposite jobs

Line trap — series gatekeeper
carrier · blocked
carrier dots approach the coil…
Line trap (wave trap) · in series
Carrier — blocked, kept out of the busbars
50 Hz power — passes, full line current
Coupling capacitor — shunt gateway
carrier · passes
carrier rides the 132 kV line…
Coupling capacitor (CVT) · shunt path
Carrier — passes, into the LMU
50 Hz power — blocked, HV kept off the electronics

Mirror-image impedances confine the carrier to exactly one line section — the trap blocks what the capacitor passes.

Dono opposite kaam karte hain — Line Trap carrier ko block karta hai, 50 Hz ko pass hone deta hai. Coupling Capacitor isse ulta karta hai aur measurement ke liye CVT ka kaam bhi karta hai. Yeh symmetry hi carrier ko ek line section mein confine karta hai. 3D models mein dono ghoom rahe hain.

04 · Equipment anatomy

The LMU — four devices, one box

Interactive 3D — watch the box open
1 · Matching transformer 2 · High-pass T-filter 3 · Drain coil 4 · Protective arrester
Why one box? Matching, filtering, draining and clamping sit as close to the coupling point as possible — every extra metre of lead adds loss and picks up interference.
1
Matching transformer
50–75 Ω coax ↔ 400–600 Ω line — efficient transfer
2
High-pass T-filter
Passes only the 40–500 kHz carrier band
3
Drain coil
50 Hz leakage & lightning surges safely to earth
4
Protective arrester
Clamps transient overvoltages before the panel

Passive, yard-mounted, weatherproof — between the CVT's LV terminal and the coax to the control room. Drain-coil earthing is critical for personnel safety.

LMU chhota box hai lekin bahut important. Isme char components hain — matching transformer impedance match karta hai, high-pass filter sirf carrier frequency pass karta hai, drain coil stray voltage ko ground karta hai, aur arrester surges se protect karta hai. 3D mein box automatically khulta hai — char parts alag ho jaate hain.

04 · Equipment anatomy

The control room's core electronics

Transmittergenerates & modulates the HF carrier
Receiverdetects & demodulates the incoming carrier
Hybrids & filtersisolate Tx from Rx on the same line
Power amplifiercompensates attenuation over distance
→ Coaxial cablethe single link out to the yard
RTU — remote terminal unit

Gathers every analog telemetry signal (4–20 mA from the transducers) and converts them into digital packets for the SLDC.

Upanalog → digital
Downremote commands

Operators at the dispatch centre can control breakers at Tifra through the same channel that brings them the data.

PLCC panel basically communication terminal hai — Tx send karta hai, Rx receive karta hai, hybrids interference avoid karte hain, amplifier distance ki attenuation cover karta hai. RTU translator hai — analog 4-20 mA signal ko digital mein convert karke SLDC bhejta hai, aur remote commands bhi receive karta hai.

Yeh device AC quantities ko clean DC signal mein convert karta hai — Class 0.2 accuracy ke saath. Response time 300 ms se kam hai, matlab sudden fluctuations bhi turant pakad leta hai. 4-in-1 programmable hai: voltage, current, power, frequency, PF aur THD 31st harmonic tak.

Why 4–20 mA?

Noise-immune over long cable runs — and the live zero (4 mA = 0 reading) makes a broken wire immediately visible.

If a value looks wrong

Walk the chain systematically — transformer → transducer → RTU input → communication → display. Never guess.

How fresh is the screen?

The RTU is polled every few seconds — what the operator sees is never more than moments old.

Yeh pura data journey hai: CT/PT step-down karte hain, RISH CON M+ calculate karke 4-20 mA deta hai, RTU digitize karta hai, PLCC line pe bhejta hai, SLDC pe SCADA dikhata hai. Agar value galat dikhe to engineers poore chain ko step-by-step check karte hain — guess nahi karte.

06 · Field work

What was actually done at Tifra

01

Yard inspection

Overheating, loose joints, corona discharge, enclosure damage, moisture, earthing.

02

Panel testing

Multimeter & level meter — transducer mA outputs verified against the real line quantities.

03

Signal verification

PLCC link levels & RTU data flow — SNR checks so the transfer stays reliable.

04

Documentation discipline

Registers & diaries keep equipment history traceable — "unconfirmed stays unconfirmed".

Why it matters: preventive inspection catches deterioration before it becomes a failure that interrupts communication — or power.
Maine yard equipment inspect kiya overheating aur damage ke liye, multimeter se transducer ka mA output verify kiya, aur signal quality checking observe ki — sab supervised tarike se. Bada lesson: agar observation confirm nahi hai, toh usse 'unconfirmed' likhna chahiye, guess nahi karna chahiye.

Appendix · Q1

Why does PLCC use the 30–500 kHz band?

Below ~30 kHz the carrier would fight the power frequency and its harmonics, and coupling components become large; above ~500 kHz the line's losses, corona noise and attenuation rise sharply. Inside 30–500 kHz the line behaves predictably, filters and couplers stay practical in size, and there is room for many separate voice, telemetry and protection channels side by side.

30 kHz se neeche power frequency ke harmonics interfere karte hain aur components bade ho jaate hain; 500 kHz se upar line losses aur corona noise badh jaati hai. Is band mein line predictable behave karti hai aur kai channels side-by-side fit ho jaate hain.

Appendix · Q2

Line trap vs coupling capacitor — which blocks what?

The line trap is in series with the line: it presents high impedance to the carrier, keeping the HF signal out of the busbars, and low impedance to 50 Hz, so bulk power passes with minimal loss. The coupling capacitor is the shunt gateway: low impedance to the carrier — letting it reach the LMU — and high impedance to 50 Hz, protecting the electronics. Mirror-image jobs, which is exactly what confines the carrier to one line section.

Line Trap series mein hota hai — carrier block, 50 Hz pass. Coupling Capacitor shunt gateway hai — carrier pass, 50 Hz block. Dono ka mirror-image kaam hi carrier ko ek section mein rakhta hai.

Appendix · Q3

Name the four components inside the LMU.

1 · Matching transformer — 50–75 Ω coax to 400–600 Ω line impedance. 2 · High-pass T-filter — passes only the 40–500 kHz carrier. 3 · Drain coil — a low-impedance path to earth for 50 Hz leakage and lightning surges. 4 · Protective arrester — clamps switching and lightning transients before they reach the panel.

Matching transformer, high-pass T-filter, drain coil, aur protective arrester — yeh chaar LMU ke andar hote hain.

Appendix · Q4

Why is telemetry from Tifra so important?

Tifra sits on the transmission network, so the SLDC's visibility of this region depends entirely on its telemetry: generation–load balance (frequency), voltage profile, and equipment status. Lose the telemetry or the carrier and the operators are flying blind — they can no longer monitor, alarm or remotely control — even though the power itself keeps flowing. That is why C&T is essential, not supplementary.

Tifra transmission network pe baitha hai — is region ki SLDC visibility poori tarah iske telemetry pe depend karti hai. Telemetry gayi to operators blind ho jaate hain, chahe bijli behti rahe. Isliye C&T essential hai, supplementary nahi.

Appendix · Q5

Why 4–20 mA and not a plain voltage signal?

A current loop is immune to cable resistance and induced noise over long panel runs — the current is the same at both ends. And the live zero is the clever part: 4 mA means a true zero reading, so a broken wire (0 mA) is instantly distinguishable from a genuine zero. 0–20 mA output is also available on the RISH CON M+.

Current loop cable resistance aur noise se immune hota hai — current dono ends pe same rehta hai. Live zero bhi clever hai: 4 mA matlab asli zero, aur 0 mA matlab wire toota hua — turant pata chal jaata hai.
